name: kimibuilt-remote-ops
description: Codex Desktop remote SSH tunnel and k3s operations workflow for the two KimiBuilt servers.

interface.shortDescription: Use Codex Desktop SSH tunnels to work against the two live KimiBuilt k3s servers.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex through the proven local-to-remote workflow for KimiBuilt: establish the active server, run read-only baselines, open local SSH forwards, verify k3s state, test public and tunneled endpoints, and clean up temporary onboarding artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use KimiBuilt Remote Ops to baseline both servers.
Open the KimiBuilt remote tunnels and test the live app through localhost.
Verify the k3s rollout and public endpoint on the main server.
